question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left back, Bob is playing fullback, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing left midfielder, Eve is playing center midfielder, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Bob trade positions. Then, Fred and Eve trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Alice trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Bob trade positions. Finally, Bob and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) left back
(B) fullback
(C) right midfielder
(D) left midfielder
(E) center midfielder
(F) benchwarmer
(G) right winger
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: left back, fullback, right midfielder, left midfielder, center midfielder, benchwarmer, right winger.
1. Gertrude–Dave: left back, fullback, right midfielder, right winger, center midfielder, benchwarmer, left midfielder.
2. Gertrude–Dave: left back, fullback, right midfielder, left midfielder, center midfielder, benchwarmer, right winger.
3. Gertrude–Bob: left back, right winger, right midfielder, left midfielder, center midfielder, benchwarmer, fullback.
4. Fred–Eve: left back, right winger, right midfielder, left midfielder, benchwarmer, center midfielder, fullback.
5. Gertrude–Alice: fullback, right winger, right midfielder, left midfielder, benchwarmer, center midfielder, left back.
6. Gertrude–Bob: fullback, left back, right midfielder, left midfielder, benchwarmer, center midfielder, right winger.
7. Bob–Dave: fullback, left midfielder, right midfielder, left back, benchwarmer, center midfielder, right winger.
Eve is the benchwarmer, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
